exposure.needed: which dashboards, alert rules or other metric consumers query querier_cache_added_total, querier_cache_gets_total or querier_cache_misses_total

consequence.statement: Consumers (dashboards, alert rules, queries) referencing the removed metrics querier_cache_added_total, querier_cache_gets_total or querier_cache_misses_total will no longer receive data; cache instrumentation is provided instead by loki_cache_fetched_keys, loki_cache_hits and loki_cache_request_duration_seconds, which instrument requests made to the configured cache (embeddedcache, memcached or redis).
consequence.remediation: Update dashboards, alert rules and other metric consumers to use loki_cache_fetched_keys, loki_cache_hits and loki_cache_request_duration_seconds instead of the removed querier_cache_* metrics.

assertion.statement: Loki 3.0.0 removes the embedded cache metrics `querier_cache_added_total`, `querier_cache_gets_total` and `querier_cache_misses_total`; requests made to the configured cache (`embeddedcache`, `memcached` or `redis`) are instead instrumented by `loki_cache_fetched_keys`, `loki_cache_hits` and `loki_cache_request_duration_seconds`.
